<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-agents.py from agents/, skills/ and commands/. Do not edit; edits are overwritten. -->

Act as the coordinator `po` for this command: read `.cursor/agents/po.md` and follow it. Start each producer and reviewer it names as a subagent from the same folder.

Any text the user typed after the command is the argument.

Run `po`'s catch-up workflow:

1. Run `python3 scripts/products-dir.py --json` to locate the products repo (handle missing setup if needed).
2. Identify the product from the command argument, or list products and ask the user which one to continue.
3. Read `<product>/.po/state.json` (including `depth`), `<product>/.po/register.jsonl` (`python3 scripts/register.py list --open --register ...`), recent `decided`/`answered` register entries, and the latest gate report in `<product>/.po/runs/`.
4. Run `python3 scripts/traces.py open-feedback --catch-up --product <slug>`: feedback not traced yet, feedback traced but not fixed, attributions waiting for the user's confirm or reject, and reruns planned or approved but not done.
5. Report where things stand (depth, current stage, locked decisions, open questions/assumptions, open feedback by severity, waiting attributions, unfinished reruns, last run summary). If five or more confirmed attributions are not in the ledger or five or more feedback lines are untraced, offer `/po-retro`. Then continue the current stage producer/reviewer loop or stage gate.
